update.title: Update the app
update.body: This version of the app is too old to keep working. Update it from the Play Store to carry on ordering.

signIn.switchBody: Choose the distributor you want to order from.

account.switchBody: You'll sign out, sign in again with your mobile number, and choose the distributor.

messages.sound: Sound while the app is open
messages.soundBody: A short sound when a message arrives while you're using the app. Your phone's silent and Do Not Disturb settings still apply.
messages.phoneSettingsBody: Turn off one kind of message, or change its sound: Orders and deliveries, Bills and payments, Offers and announcements.

privacy.phoneTitle: What the app keeps on this phone
privacy.phoneBody: Your sign-in, your language and settings, and for weak connections your cart and recent pages. Signing out removes them.
